Implemented CPU S-matrix candidate:

  • Thin certified solves apply x − L(Ux) without constructing dense LU.
  • Adjoint applies x − Uᴴ(Lᴴx) using reflection blocks already retained by the caller.
  • Upward-rounded quadratic certificate preserves the existing dense-product and pivoted-LU fallbacks.
  • No public API changes or extra retained matrices.

Verified: all 28 S-matrix Rust tests passed across two runs, including dense reference comparisons, adjoints, cancellation/singular cases, and a new n=512 lossless-power/physical-angle gradient test. Independent read-only review found no consequential issues. Files formatted.

Performance remains for root’s release benchmarks. Existing random dense fixture will generally retain its previous path; expected gains concern structured weak reflections. Watch potential subnormal overhead from upward-rounding exact zeros in the certificate.

Edits remain frozen for benchmarking. No commits, pushes, docs, or PR changes.
